feel-noiseind.intent: loose and abrasive: irregular slam kick, press hits, shatter shards (100-130 bpm).
feel-noiseind.code:
setcpm(120/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:atoms-industrial")
$: s(atoms.ind.noiseKick).hook("doorSlam | groove-human(4, 0.25, 1)")
$: s(atoms.ind.hits2).hook("stampPress | groove-human(4, 0.25, 2)")
$: s(atoms.ind.hits7).hook("metalImpact | groove-human(4, 0.25, 3)")
$: s(atoms.ind.chain16).velocity(atoms.ind.chainVel).hook("chainRattle | groove-human(4, 0.25, 4)")
$: note(atoms.ind.shards).hook("metalShatter | groove-human(4, 0.25, 5)")
$: note(atoms.ind.clankLine).hook("clankBass | groove-human(4, 0.25, 6)")
$: note(atoms.ind.bedNote).hook("rustBed | groove-human(4, 0.25, 7)")
$: s("~ x").hook("hydraulicHiss | groove-human(4, 0.25, 8)")
feel-noiseind.notes: Craft form of the feel template glyphcore/industrial:feel-noiseind (atoms and rack | groove hooks); the Strudel tab has racks and grooves written out. To use the whole template: atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:feel-noiseind", { as: "feel" }).
